title: Blue Tsunami: Watch Zeteo’s Coverage with Mehdi, Prem, Mallory McMorrow, Jamaal Bowman, Rep. Greg Casar, and More!
author: Team Zeteo
content:
Did you miss **Zeteo 's** election night live stream? Catch the full replay
now and relive the exciting night as results came in!

**Mehdi** and **Prem** were LIVE from **Michigan** where **Abdul El-Sayed**
declared victory to become the first Muslim Senator in U.S. history**.** The
historic win came as Democrats took control of the House and Senate,
outperforming in many states in what has turned out to be a blue tsunami
([Watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m4UaAGFTPVs) to see how Prem coined a
new word for it).

The live stream featured an all-star roster of special guests, including
**Rep. Greg Casar** , **Mahmoud Khalil** , **Michigan State Rep. Alabas
Farhat** , former **Rep. Andy Levin** , United Auto Workers president **Shawn
Fain** , Dearborn Mayor**Abdullah Hammoud,** and more.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**Mallory McMorrow** , who ran against El-Sayed in the primary, noted that,
"**We have to completely change this [Democratic] party from the ground up.
And I worry that if we didn 't do that, then Democrats would deserve to
lose**."

And former **Rep. Jamal Bowman** predicted that **Haley Stevens** "**is going
to go down as the ultimate villain of this American reckoning**."

Meanwhile, senior political correspondent **Swin Suebsaeng** reported live
from**Ohio,** where **Vivek Ramaswamy** suffered a humiliating defeat in the
race for governor against Democrat **Amy Acton**.

**[Watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m4UaAGFTPVs)** to see Mehdi and
Prem's live reactions to some of the biggest political earthquakes in modern
history, and Mehdi calling out Elon Musk for his failed efforts to keep Texas
red.
